title: Cellular Respiration & Bioenergetics
subject: Biology
description: How cells harvest energy from nutrients: glycolysis, the citric acid cycle, the electron transport chain and chemiosmosis, built up one mechanism at a time from the syllabus of BIO 301.

title: Chemical Reaction Kinetics
subject: Chemistry
description: What controls the rate of a reaction: rate laws, reaction order, the Arrhenius equation, reaction mechanisms and catalysis, taught in dependency order from CHM 210.

title: Linear Systems & Matrix Algebra
subject: Mathematics
description: From a single linear equation to eigenvalues: Gaussian elimination, matrix algebra, determinants, vector spaces and diagonalization, wired so each idea rests on the one before it.
